name: Piglet processing
duplicates: The old UI (Figma 生产任务 › 仔猪处理) has a task-in-progress and a task-ended flow. The same litter-by-litter care is not drawn elsewhere, but piglet counts are also asked in Farrowing (born, dead).
flow: tap a pen (the sheet shows that pen's status)
tap a job chip (Iron, Dock tail, Castrate, Coccidiosis, Tag)
tap the Task side of the summary card
tap the piglet count on a ticked item
tap Tag piglets, the ID item or the Tagged fact
tap Tag a piglet, or a piglet to fix it

notes.purpose: One row per pen (a pen is one sow with her litter) so the worker sees what each pen still needs and walks the pens.
states: The prototype keeps no screen in the URL beyond the params named here; every other state is reached by tapping, and the data lives in sessionStorage (key pp-simple-v5), so a reload keeps records but starts on the pen list.

Params the app reads: `chip` (iron | tail | castrate | cocci | id | done), `scheme` (tag | notch | breeders | none), `pen` (a pen code), `lang` (en | zh). Home forwards layout, from, section, entry, unit and returnUnit; the app reads none of them.
Mixed day on first load: 12 pens, one batch (Batch 40), pens aged day 1 to 6; A01 done, B01 late, B02 sow died, B05/B06 coming.
Chips show only the jobs that at least one pen needs today (the selected chip stays even at 0).
The farm setting (Tag every piglet, Notch every piglet, Tag breeders only, No ID) and the language sit in a Demo panel outside the phone; switching the setting restarts the demo.

elements.name: Header
elements.logic: Task name; no Back button (nothing to go back to inside the prototype).

elements.name: Latest line
elements.logic: The newest record of any kind on any pen (treatment, ID, death, move, count), its clock time and who. "Nothing recorded yet" when none. Shows the time only, never the date.

elements.name: Summary card · left half
elements.logic: The first job on the plan order (Iron, Dock tail, Castrate, Coccidiosis, then the ID step) that any pen needs today, and how many pens need it; "needs today" = the step is due, late, or has piglets left from an earlier save. When nothing is due: "Due today · 0 · nothing due". The support line is "Batch 40", or "Batch 40 · 3 piglets unaccounted" when Set count has lowered counts.
elements.source: listScreen(); needsToday(); sp.sum.due, sp.sum.pens, sp.sum.none, sp.sum.nothing, sp.batch, sp.batch.unacc

elements.name: Summary card · right half
elements.shows: Task · 3 / 12 · pens done · Tap to end the task
elements.logic: Pens done over all pens, with a bar. A pen counts as done when it has nothing left to do today, which includes pens whose steps are all still ahead (B05, B06). Tapping the half opens End task.

elements.name: Chips row
elements.shows: All 12 · Iron 6 · Dock tail 4 · Castrate 6 · Coccidiosis 6 · Tag 7 · Done 3
elements.logic: One radio group that only filters the list. Each count = pens where that step is due, late or has some left. The Tag chip is named by the scheme (Tag, Notch, Breeders) and absent on a No-ID farm. Done = pens with nothing left to do.

elements.name: Pen header
elements.logic: Pen code and a fixed "1 sow" (one sow per pen); tapping the header opens the pen.

elements.name: Pen row · sow ID
elements.logic: The sow's ear tag, mono.

elements.name: Pen row · chip
elements.logic: One chip at most: amber Late if any step is late; red Sow died if the sow died; green To do if anything is due; Done when nothing is due and nothing is ahead; no chip when every step is still ahead. Chips disappear after End.

elements.name: Pen row · headline
elements.logic: The steps still to do, in plan order. With nothing to do and steps ahead: the forecast "Iron tomorrow" / "Castrate in 2 days" (the nearest start day). With everything done: the piglet count ("12 piglets"). After End: "Task ended".

elements.name: Pen row · meta
elements.logic: Piglets alive now · pen age in days · time (or mm/dd if not today) of the pen's newest record · that record's worker as initial.surname-initial. The piglet count is dropped when it is already the headline. Pens with no record show just count and day.

elements.name: Pen row · trailing
elements.logic: Chevron; a pencil on done pens (an edit cue). Tapping anywhere opens the pen sheet.

controls.does: filters the list to pens that need the job

controls.control: Task half of the summary card

edge: A pen whose sow died stays on its schedule (Round 2 Q18); the chip is red Sow died unless a step is late.
An empty filter prints "No pen needs this now." or "No pen is done yet."
Singular forms: "1 piglet", "Iron tomorrow".
Unseen two-phone notes appear as amber warnings under the latest line.
rules: Round 5: list row = id + one chip, one headline, one meta line; "look like farrowing".
Round 9: "Bulk = chips."
Round 7: identity is owed only where the farm's scheme requires it; a "none" scheme shows none.
issues: "Done" pens include pens that have not started (B05, B06 count as done), so "3 / 12 pens done" overstates progress. (Open item 2 in HANDOFF.)
The summary card names only the first job (Iron 6) while the chips show larger ones (Tag 7); the card and chips disagree about what is "today's" number.

The Tag chip filters only; the Round 9 ruling and HANDOFF describe chips with tick-through pens and a "Finish iron treatment" hold, and the strings (sp.bulk.*) and PPS.bulk() remain, but no bulk screen exists in app.js.
The latest line shows a time without a date, so "Last record 08:20" can be yesterday's.
The pen header shows "1 sow" on every pen; the pen code and sow ID are shown twice (header and row).
Home says Batch 27 / 8 pens / care due tomorrow; this list is Batch 40 / 12 pens / 6 pens due today.
No way back to Home.

screens.name: Pen list · one job
screens.zh: 栏位列表 · 单项处理

notes.purpose: Shows only the pens that need one job today, so the worker can walk them with the treatment in hand.
states: `?chip=iron` (also tail, castrate, cocci, id). The chip is selected; counts stay.
Selecting the Tag chip adds the note that IDs go in one piglet at a time (sp.chip.id.tip exists in strings; not shown in the current screen).

elements.name: Filtered rows
elements.logic: Pens where the step is due, late or has some left (same rule as the chip count). Rows are unchanged.

edge: A selected chip with count 0 stays visible and shows "No pen needs this now."
rules: Round 9: tap a job chip and every pen that needs it is listed.
issues: The list is only a filter; the pens still have to be opened one at a time to record (no tick-through).

notes.purpose: Lists pens with nothing left to do.
states: `?chip=done`: A01 (all done), B05 and B06 (nothing due yet) in the sample.

elements.name: Rows
elements.shows: A01 · Done · 12 piglets; B05 · Iron tomorrow
elements.logic: Pens with an empty to-do list. Done pens end in an edit pencil instead of a chevron.

edge: Empty: "No pen is done yet."
issues: Pens that have not started appear under Done.

screens.name: Pen list · farm without ID
screens.zh: 栏位列表 · 不编号的猪场

notes.purpose: Shows the list for fatteners raised as a batch, where no piglet gets an ID.
states: `?scheme=none`: no ID step, no Tag chip, no tagged facts; other schemes via `scheme=tag|notch|breeders`.

elements.name: Missing parts
elements.shows: no Tag chip · no "Tag" in the headlines · no tool
elements.logic: The plan has four treatments only; the Piglets card shows only Boars · gilts and Litter weight.

edge: Switching the setting restarts the demo with that farm's data.
rules: Round 7: "A farm whose scheme is no identity owes no tagging and shows none."
issues: The scheme is a demo switch outside the phone; unclear how a farm's scheme is set in the real product (open in Round 1 Q3).

screens.name: Pen list · two phones recorded the same job
screens.zh: 栏位列表 · 两部手机冲突

notes.purpose: Shows what the worker sees when another phone recorded the same treatment first.
states: How to reach: record Iron on A05 on this phone, then press "Demo: another phone recorded iron on A05" in the Demo panel. The list shows an amber note; the A05 sheet shows the other worker's record in Done and "yours kept as a note".

elements.name: Note
elements.shows: Iron for A05 was already recorded by L. Madsen at 08:40. Yours is kept as a note.
elements.logic: First record in wins; the second is kept as a note, both stamped. Dismiss with OK.

edge: If the other phone's record arrives before this phone recorded, the sheet says "L. Madsen's phone recorded Iron on A05 at 08:40."
After End the demo says the task has ended.
rules: Round 1 Q8: offline collisions are kept, never merged (simplified here to first-in-wins; HANDOFF open item 1).
issues: Two same-record collision answers from Round 4/6 ("Given twice", "Different piglets") are dropped in this prototype.

screens.name: Pen sheet · nothing due yet
screens.zh: 栏位详情 · 还没到时间

notes.purpose: The pen sheet for a day-1 pen whose treatments start tomorrow.
states: `?pen=B05` (day 1) or B06. All steps are "coming" (Iron and Dock tail from day 2; others from day 3); the list shows "Iron tomorrow" and no chip.
Items of later days can still be ticked early and are marked early.

elements.name: Sheet title
elements.logic: The pen's sow ID (p.sow). The pen code is in the subtitle.

elements.name: Sheet subtitle
elements.logic: Pen code and the sow's parity, piglets alive now (born − dead, adjusted by deaths, moves and Set count), pen age in days (day 1 = born). Parity is sample data.

elements.name: Piglets card
elements.shows: Piglets · View log › · Boars · gilts 6 · 6 · Litter weight 24.6 kg · Tagged 4 of 12 · Breeders kept 1
elements.logic: Heading with the "View log ›" link, then up to four facts, each a button into its own sheet. Boars · gilts = the litter's saved split, or counted from the IDs once every alive piglet has one; "—" when unknown. Litter weight = the last weight saved (kg), "—" when none, with the hint "Weigh the litter: growth figures need it." Tagged/Notched "n of m" = piglets with an ID over alive; Breeders kept = IDs flagged as breeders. The two ID facts appear only on a farm that has an ID step (not "No ID"). There is no separate piglets-alive figure: it is in the subtitle.
elements.source: pigletsCard(); sp.pc.title, sp.pc.log, sp.pg.sex, sp.pg.weight, sp.pc.tagged, sp.pg.breeders, sp.pg.weight.hint

elements.name: Tool row
elements.logic: Three tools as farrowing's row. Tag piglets is named by the farm scheme (Tag piglets, Notch piglets, Pick breeders) and is absent on a "No ID" farm; the row is hidden after End task.

elements.name: Processing heading
elements.logic: Section heading above the age-day cards.

elements.name: Age-day card
elements.logic: One card per plan day: Iron and Dock tail on day 2; Castrate, Coccidiosis and the ID step on day 3. The status line is "Planned mm/dd" (today minus the gap between the pen's age and that day) for days up to today, or "Not due yet · can be done early" for later days. A card disappears once all its items are done.

elements.name: Item row · coming
elements.shows: Iron · day 2–4 · Not due yet · can be done early
elements.logic: Not-yet-due days carry the early status; a tick is allowed and saved with an early mark.

elements.name: Footer
elements.logic: Back closes the sheet and drops the unsaved ticks. Submit saves every ticked item as a stamped record (who, when, count; marked early or late if outside its window) and is disabled at 0 ticks; it is absent after End task. After saving, a line "2 items saved · Undo" appears; Undo takes those records back.

edge: No Done card yet.
rules: Round 1 Q6: "Early is allowed for any scheduled item actually done, counts on time."
issues: Everything is greyed as not due yet but nothing says when the first item opens except the list headline.

notes.purpose: Where the worker records a pen: tick what was done, adjust the count, submit once.
states: `?pen=A03` (day 4): Iron 10 of 12 given with 2 left (weak); Dock tail done; Castrate and Coccidiosis due; ID due.
Ticked: a row shows the check disc and its piglet count; Submit shows the count of ticked items.
Saved: the receipt line "N items saved · Undo", the rows turn done in place for about four seconds, then fold into Done.

elements.name: Item row · due
elements.logic: One tick per treatment. Meta = the window in pen-age days from PLAN (Iron 2-4, Dock tail 2-4, Castrate 3-7, Coccidiosis 3-5; the ID step 3-7). Tapping ticks it into a draft (nothing is saved until Submit); a ticked row shows the piglet count ("12 piglets" = alive minus already given) as a button that opens the count sheet. Late items add an amber "late"; ticking an item of a later day adds an amber "early".
elements.source: dayItem(); state.js PLAN; sp.given.days, sp.late, sp.item.early

elements.name: Item row · some left
elements.logic: A treatment saved for fewer piglets than alive keeps the rest on the list with the reason given (weak, sick, or "moved in" for arrivals).

elements.name: Item row · ID step
elements.shows: Tag piglets · Not filled · 4 of 12 tagged
elements.logic: The ID step is not ticked; it opens the Piglets list. Meta: amber "Filled"/"Not filled" (Filled when any ID is recorded; on a breeders-only farm when the pick is done), then progress words from the farm scheme ("4 of 12 tagged", "4 of 12 notched", "1 breeder picked"), plus "late" when past day 7.

elements.name: Done card
elements.logic: Treatments and the ID step already done sit folded in one card at the bottom ("Done · N items") with the names ("Iron · Dock tail") and a Show/Hide row. Opened, each row shows "day 2 · G.H 10/05 08:05 · 12 piglets", an amber early/late mark and, if another phone got there first, "yours kept as a note (hh:mm)". A step saved in this visit stays in its day card about four seconds before moving here.
elements.source: processing(); sp.proc.done, sp.proc.done.n, sp.tl.open, sp.tl.close, sp.kept.note

controls.does: ticks or unticks the item (the ID row opens the Piglets list)

controls.control: Piglet count on a ticked item
controls.does: opens the count for that item

controls.control: Tagged / Breeders kept facts, Tag piglets tool, ID row

controls.does: saves ticked items and stays on the sheet

edge: Submit with 0 ticks is disabled.
After End task: warning "Task ended. Nothing more can be recorded." and the tool row, Submit and ticks are gone.
A death or Set count lowers alive; treatments given are capped at alive.
When another phone recorded the same item, the Done row says "yours kept as a note".
rules: Round 2 Q16: "Every treatment: one tap records all live piglets; lowering the number asks a reason for the rest."
Round 1 Q6: late stays due, carries its real date, counts late.
Round 5: the litter opens as a drawer over the list "like a sow in farrowing".
issues: The ticked count button ("12 piglets") looks like a value, not a control.
Dates in the day cards ("Planned 10/07") are computed from the pen's age, not from a farrowing date.
The pen's sow ID is the sheet title but the sow is not shown as a tappable record (no link to Farrowing).
The Piglets card has four facts that are each a button; the weight and the boar/gilt split open different sheets from one card.

screens.name: Pen sheet · breeders-only farm
screens.zh: 栏位详情 · 只给种猪编号

notes.purpose: The same sheet when the farm tags only the piglets kept for breeding.
states: `?scheme=breeders&pen=A02`: the ID step is "Pick breeders", progress words are "1 breeder picked", and it is done only when the worker taps Done picking on the Piglets list.

elements.name: Tool
elements.logic: Replaces Tag piglets.

elements.name: ID item
elements.logic: Filled once the pick is closed (p.picked).

elements.name: Piglets card
elements.shows: Boars · gilts · Litter weight · Tagged x of y · Breeders kept
elements.logic: On this scheme "n of m" is not counted; the facts show breeders.

edge: A pick can close with no breeders ("Done picking · no breeders").
rules: Round 7: identity follows each farm's standard.

notes.purpose: A pen that missed a treatment window.
states: `?pen=B01` (day 6): Iron was never given (window 2-4); the row is amber "late". Saving it carries the mark late. The list shows the amber Late chip and "late · day 6" on the End page.

elements.name: Item row · late
elements.logic: Past the window end (pen age > to): status late, still tickable.

elements.name: Record mark
elements.logic: A record made outside the window is stamped late automatically; early is the mirror. No question is asked.

edge: The ID step turns late after day 7.
rules: Round 1 Q6: "late stays due until done or task end … counts late; no clinical cut-off in v1" (amended by Round 2 Q15 for window-bound treatments: missed; not modelled here).
issues: The "missed" state of Round 2 Q15 is not shown; everything past its window is "late" forever.

screens.name: Pen sheet · all done
screens.zh: 栏位详情 · 全部完成

notes.purpose: A pen with every step recorded.
states: `?pen=A01`: four treatments given and 12 of 12 tagged. No day cards; only the Done card, folded ("5 items · Iron · Dock tail · Castrate · Coccidiosis · Tag piglets"), plus the Piglets card with 6 boars · 6 gilts.

elements.name: Empty line
elements.shows: Nothing left to do in this pen.
elements.logic: Shown only when there are neither day cards nor done items.

edge: The tool row still offers Record death and More.
issues: Done items cannot be corrected here except by Undo within the visit; fixing a treatment later has no door (Edit was cut in the simplification; HANDOFF open item 1).

notes.purpose: Records that a treatment was given to fewer piglets than are alive in the pen.
states: How to reach: on a pen sheet tick an item, then tap its piglet count. A long sheet: title = the treatment, subtitle "A03 · 10 to do", a stepper "Piglets given" from 1 to the number still to do; when fewer, a radio "Why fewer?" (Weak, Sick) and the line "The other 2 stay on the list for later.", primary "Use 8" disabled until a reason is chosen.

elements.name: Stepper
elements.logic: Starts at the number still owed (alive minus given), min 1.

elements.name: Why fewer
elements.logic: Required only when the count is lower; becomes the reason shown on the item ("2 left · weak").

controls.does: keeps the count on the draft

edge: A moved-in pen shows the reason "moved in".
rules: Round 2 Q15/Q16: a skip carries a reason; deferred ones stay due.
issues: Only two reasons (weak, sick); hernia, cryptorchid and "kept boar" exempt reasons from Round 2 are gone (simplification).

notes.purpose: Shows the pen's identified piglets and starts giving IDs.
states: How to reach: on a pen sheet tap Tag piglets, the ID item, or the Tagged or Breeders kept fact. Title "Piglets", description "A02 · Sow 000238". Sample A02: 4 of 12 tagged.
Empty: "No piglet has an ID yet." On a breeders-only farm a secondary button "Done picking · N breeders" closes the pick.

elements.name: Hint
elements.shows: Tap a piglet to fix it. Tap the flag to keep it for breeding.
elements.logic: Shown when at least one piglet has an ID and the task is open.

elements.name: Group header
elements.logic: Scheme word, progress, breeders count.

elements.name: Row · ID
elements.logic: Tag number, or notch number (litter-number-piglet) on a notch farm; both if both exist.

elements.name: Row · chip
elements.logic: Green chip when the piglet is flagged for breeding.

elements.name: Row · headline
elements.logic: Sex and optional weight.

elements.name: Row · meta
elements.logic: Time (only for today) and the worker who tagged it.

elements.name: Flag button
elements.logic: Toggles breeder; stamps a record.

elements.name: Primary
elements.logic: Per scheme: Tag a piglet, Notch a piglet, Tag a breeder. Absent after End.

controls.does: opens it in Give IDs to fix

edge: On a notch farm the group says "Notched".
After End: no flag, no primary, rows not tappable.
rules: Round 10: breeder selection may become a universal per-pig feature; ranking is a placeholder.
issues: "Tagged x of y" appears in the group, the Piglets card and the ID item meta: three places for one figure.

screens.name: Give IDs (one piglet at a time)

notes.purpose: Records one piglet's tag or notch, its sex and optionally its weight, then moves to the next.
states: How to reach: Piglets list › Tag a piglet (or a piglet row to fix it). Title "Give IDs" ("Pick breeders" on a breeders farm), description "A02 · sow 000238 · 8 without ID", or "Fixing 001201".
The Numpad opens when a readout is tapped; it closes by tapping the readout again.

elements.name: Last line
elements.logic: Receipt of the previous piglet; Undo removes it.

elements.name: Tag readout
elements.logic: Prefilled with the next number on the strip (farm-wide highest tag + 1; strip starts at 001201). Typing replaces it, up to 6 digits; on a notch farm the readout is the pen's next piglet number (max 2 digits) and the saved ID is litter-number-piglet. A scan button reads the next tag (demo).

elements.name: Duplicate guard
elements.logic: Refused tone; blocks Record when the number is on any pen of the farm.

elements.name: Sex tiles
elements.logic: Required (Record stays disabled until one is chosen).

elements.name: Weight
elements.logic: kg, one decimal, up to two integer digits.

elements.name: Primary
elements.logic: Saves at once (nothing waits for Submit) and returns a fresh form at the next number; in fix mode "Save change". Breeders farm: the piglet is a breeder automatically.

edge: Number already used on the farm.
A cleared readout shows "—".
After End: no primary.
rules: Round 10: per-piglet work as a universal feature (direction only); the shape is farrowing's identity pattern.
issues: No stop: after the last piglet the form keeps offering another; the number left ("8 without ID") is only in the description.
Sex is required here but the Round 1 Q3 ruling says sex and weight never block a row.

notes.purpose: Saves the litter's boar and gilt counts when not every piglet is identified.
states: How to reach: pen sheet › Boars · gilts. Two steppers (Boars, Gilts), subtitle "A03 · day 4"; Save. Starting values are the saved split, or counted from IDs when every piglet has one.

elements.name: Steppers
elements.logic: Whole numbers from 0; no check against the alive count.

elements.name: Receipt
elements.logic: The flash line after Save.

issues: unclear: the sum is not checked against piglets alive.

notes.purpose: Records the weight of the whole litter on the day.
states: How to reach: pen sheet › Litter weight. One readout "Weight (kg)" on the Numpad (one decimal, up to 3 integer digits); Save disabled until above zero.

elements.name: Readout
elements.logic: Appended as a new weigh (kept with its pen age); the Piglets card shows the latest.

rules: Glossary: litter weight is one record per weigh day.
issues: A second weighing on the same day is appended, not replaced as the glossary says.
No plausibility check (the glossary refuses over 6 kg per piglet).

notes.purpose: Holds the two rarer tools.
states: How to reach: pen sheet › More. Medium sheet with two doors: Move piglets, Set count.

elements.name: Doors
elements.logic: Two rows with icons.

notes.purpose: Records piglets that died, by cause.
states: How to reach: pen sheet › Record death. Four steppers (Crushed, Scours, Starve-out, Other), each capped at alive; subtitle "A03 · 12 alive"; Save disabled at 0.

elements.name: Result
elements.logic: Alive drops by the total, Dead rises, treatments given are capped at alive; log line "Died · 3".

edge: Individual tagged piglets are not picked as dead.
rules: Round 1 Q9: processing marks deaths through the one shared dead picker, which also lists tagged piglets (not built here).
issues: This is a count-by-cause sheet, not the shared dead picker the ruling requires; tagged piglets stay on the Piglets list after a death.

notes.purpose: Moves piglets to another pen of the batch and carries what they already had.
states: How to reach: pen sheet › More › Move piglets. Page "Move piglets", description "From A03 · 12 alive".

elements.name: To pen
elements.logic: One tile per other pen of the batch (pen age 1-6; here every other pen) with its day.

elements.name: How many
elements.logic: Hero stepper 1 to alive.

elements.name: Had treatment?
elements.logic: One Yes/No per treatment already given in the source pen; with a tag or notch farm and IDs on the pen: "Have tags?" / "Notched?". All must be answered.

elements.name: Primary
elements.logic: Moves them; "had" answers shift the given count to the other pen; otherwise the receiving pen marks the owed piglets "moved in".

edge: Only pens of this batch are offered; no other room.
The answer "Don't know" of Round 2 Q14 is cut.
rules: Round 9: "Move only offers pens in the task (and batch)."
issues: The Move does not suggest the receiving pen from time and room (Round 2 suggestion is cut).
Piglets identified before the move keep their tags but do not move their IDs to the new pen (the count shifts only).

notes.purpose: Corrects the pen's piglet count to what is really there now.
states: How to reach: pen sheet › More › Set count. Hero stepper "Piglets alive", subtitle "A03 · was 12". Save disabled while unchanged. No reason is asked.

elements.name: Batch checker
elements.logic: The drop (old minus new) is added to a task-level total; a higher count lowers it. Shown on the list summary and in End task. Not a pen status.

edge: A treatment fully given stays fully given at the new count.
rules: Round 9: "Set count just adjusts the pen's record to what is there now. No reason question … kept only in the overall checker."
issues: The unaccounted figure never shows which pen it came from.

notes.purpose: Shows every record of the pen as history, newest first by day.
states: How to reach: pen sheet › View log. Groups "day 6 … day 0"; day 0 holds "Born 13" and "1 dead at birth".

elements.name: Entries
elements.logic: Treatments, deaths, moves, counts, IDs, breeder picks and weights, with who and when (time if today, else mm/dd + time).

edge: Weights show no actor.
rules: Round 1 Q7: stamped history; no deletion.
issues: Born is farrowing's number and cannot be seen or corrected from here; weight lines show no who or when.

notes.purpose: Reviews what is not done and ends the task by a hold.
states: How to reach: pen list › the Task half of the summary card. Description "Piglet processing · Batch 40".

elements.name: Progress
elements.shows: 3 of 12 pens done · 9 pens not done
elements.logic: Same done rule as the list (includes pens not yet started). "All pens done" when none are left.

elements.name: Not done list
elements.shows: A02 · Castrate · Coccidiosis · Tag · due today · 12 piglets
elements.logic: Pens with something to do; the second line is the first treatment's count with "due today" or "late · day 6", or "2 left · weak" when only partials remain; chips for Late and Sow died.

elements.name: Not due yet
elements.shows: Not due yet in 2 pens: Iron, Dock tail. Ending the task stops these too.
elements.logic: Pens with steps still ahead, with the step names.

elements.name: Unaccounted
elements.shows: 3 piglets unaccounted in this batch: counts came in lower than the records.
elements.logic: Only when above zero.

elements.name: Hold button
elements.logic: Danger hold; on completion the task is ended.

edge: Always available; there is no check that the batch's farrowing is closed.
rules: Round 1 Q5: manual only, review in numbers, hold-to-commit, cannot end while the batch's farrowing task is open.
Round 4: End is allowed with review items open.
issues: The ruling that End is blocked while farrowing is open is not built.
Not-yet-started pens are counted done and also listed under "Not due yet": the same pens are counted twice in opposite ways.
unclear: who may end (the code comment says the supervisor; no role check).

screens.name: Pen list · task ended
screens.zh: 栏位列表 · 任务已结束

notes.purpose: The same list after End: read-only.
states: How to reach: hold End task. Summary left half "Not done · N · pens", right half "Task ended · hh:mm · name". Rows read "Task ended"; chips gone; End page shows a receipt "Piglet processing ended · 08:20 · G. Hansen" and the "Not given" group.

elements.name: Pen sheet banner
elements.shows: Task ended. Nothing more can be recorded.
elements.logic: Amber warning; tool row, ticks and Submit are removed.

edge: After End the other-phone demo says the task has ended.
rules: Round 3: after End no new treatment marks; Round 1 Q7 allowed corrections and ID rows stay writable (the prototype blocks all writes).
issues: Nothing can be corrected after End, against Round 1 Q7 (corrections stay writable, stamped).
